name: SWEEP-S8v2 Crowded table
_design: New idea from S1/S6 v1-v2 (monitor 1): observe(point) lists only one point, so agents that start apart almost never see, meet or talk (S1v1/S1v2: 0 messages; S6v2: the only 2 messages came from roommates). Co-location removes that bottleneck: observe(here) lists everyone, send/transfer/attack all work at once. 8 identical agents start together at the centre of an empty 11x11 world, at one tree holding 2 ripe fruit, with 15 more trees scattered (16 total, about 1 per 7.5 tiles). 150 compute each, 30% absorption, thinking ~4.3 per decision, vision 3, communication 4, a dead agent's compute is loot. Question: in a crowd at a table that feeds one, who eats, who talks, who leaves, does anyone share or take? | v2 fix (world only): S8v1 cut at r23: the table held 2 fruit and refilled every 5 rounds, so all 8 left by r7-11, 33 of 45 moves were 'right' (all drifted east, past full trees 1 step W/N/SW) and 5 of 8 were broke by r23 with 0 messages. Changes: every tree fruits every 2 rounds instead of 5 (mature energy inflow 12 -> 30 per round, so a 60-energy fruit every 2 rounds; the table now feeds about 1.5 agents, not 8), and trees 16 -> 8 (the table + 7 random) so the world stays about as rich overall and the table is the one reliable place. Everything else unchanged.
